info.title: ODS Chatbot API
info.description: API for interacting with ODS Chatbot

post.description:
Create a new conversation

Args:
    conversation_service:
    request: The conversation creation request
    client_id: The client identifier from header
    session_id: The session identifier from header

Returns:
    CreateGetConversationResponse: The ID of the conversation

get.description:
Get the user conversations.

Args:
    conversation_service:
    request:
    client_id: The client identifier from header
    session_id: The session identifier from header

Returns:
    Response: List of conversations a user has

Get the user conversations with ID

Args:
    conversation_service:
    request:
    conversation_id: The conversation identifier
    client_id: The client identifier from header
    session_id: The session identifier from header

Returns:
    Response: List of conversations a user has

post.description:
Save a conversation

Args:
    conversation_service:
    conversation_id: The conversation identifier
    request: The message to be saved
    client_id: The client identifier from header
    session_id: The session identifier from header

Returns:
    Successful save

put.description:
Update a conversation

Args:
    conversation_service:
    conversation_id: The conversation identifier
    request: The message to be saved
    client_id: The client identifier from header
    session_id: The session identifier from header

Returns:
    Successful save

delete.description:
Delete a conversation

Args:
    conversation_service:
    conversation_id: The conversation identifier
    request: The message to be saved
    client_id: The client identifier from header
    session_id: The session identifier from header

Returns:
    Successful save

post.description:
Send a message to the agent

Args:
    conversation_service:
    conversation_id: The conversation identifier
    request: The message to be sent
    client_id: The client identifier from header
    session_id: The session identifier from header

Returns:
    The response from the agent

Save feedback for a conversation response.

Args:
    request: The feedback request containing score, scoring_type, response_id and message
    feedback_service: The feedback service to use for saving feedback

Creates a new session.

Args:
    session_service:
    request: The session creation request
    client_id: The client identifier from header

Returns:
    CreateSessionResponse: The ID of the session

get.description:
Creates a new configuraion.

Args:
    configuration_service:
    request: The get configuration request
    client_id: The client identifier from header

Returns:
    GetConfigurationResponse: The configuration details

Returns the avatar blob for the given client ID.

Args:
    configuration_service:
    request: The request object
    client_id: The client identifier from header

Returns the profiles for the given client ID.

Args:
    configuration_service:
    request: The request object
    client_id: The client identifier from header

WelcomeAnswer.title: WelcomeAnswer
WelcomeAnswer.description:
Data structure containing information about an answer.
The answer can be used by the user's app to iterate interactions with the virtual agent
and can be composed of, for example, text, images, and video content.

WelcomeInfo.title: WelcomeInfo
WelcomeInfo.description: Data structure containing information about a welcome message and its language.

WelcomeMessage.title: WelcomeMessage
WelcomeMessage.description:
Data structure containing information about a welcome message.
The message can be used by the user's app to iterate interactions with the virtual agent
and can be composed of, for example, text, images, and video content.

WelcomeSuggestion.title: WelcomeSuggestion
WelcomeSuggestion.description:
Data structure containing information about a suggestion.
The suggestion can be used by the user's app to iterate interactions with the virtual agent.
